Dropi browser conversion — third-party notices

All conversion dependencies are served by this site. No file-processing API is used.

pdfjs-dist 5.6.205 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
fflate 0.8.3 — MIT — https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
heic-to 1.6.7 — MIT — https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
UTIF 3.1.0 — MIT — https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js
pako 1.0.11 — MIT AND Zlib — https://github.com/nodeca/pako

heic-to includes libheif 1.23.7 and codec components. Its corresponding source and build instructions are available at https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to and https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7 .

See the adjacent LICENSE-* files, and licenses in wasm/ and standard_fonts/.
Exact vendored versions and npm distribution integrity are recorded in vendor-manifest.json in the website source.
